title: Add guest-mode messaging, Discord community info, and a basic Go Live feature

requirements.text: Surface OmniStream Discord community information in the app UI using the provided Discord server name and contact username: server "ommistream" and user/contact "scottiscool".

quotes: discord is scottiscool and server is ommistream

acceptanceCriteria: The footer (or another always-visible section) displays Discord server name "ommistream" and contact "scottiscool" in English.
No third-party Discord authentication/integration is added.
If any social icons/links remain that do not have real URLs, they do not misleadingly imply an official Discord link unless a URL is explicitly provided.

requirements.text: Make the guest experience explicit in the UI: when the user is not authenticated, clearly indicate they are browsing as a guest and that uploading/posting requires signing in.

quotes: no sogn in u can be a gest on it but can't post into your sign in

acceptanceCriteria: When not signed in, at least one prominent UI location (e.g., NavBar and/or Upload page) shows "Browsing as a guest" (or equivalent) in English.
Upload page unauthenticated state explicitly states that guests can browse but must sign in to upload/post.
Authenticated users do not see guest-only messaging.

requirements.text: Add a basic "Go Live" capability as a first MVP: allow authenticated users to create and end a live session (metadata-only), and allow all users (including guests) to browse a list of live sessions and view a live session details page.
acceptanceCriteria: A new "Live" (or "Go Live") entry point is available in the app navigation and routes to a dedicated page.
Guests can view a public list of live sessions (including an empty state when none exist).
Authenticated users can start a live session by providing, at minimum, a title; the session becomes visible in the public list as "Live".
Authenticated users can end a live session they started; ended sessions are clearly marked as ended or are removed from the "Live now" list (implementation choice, but must be consistent).

Backend exposes canister methods to create, end, list, and fetch live session metadata, with access control that prevents guests from creating/ending sessions and prevents users from ending sessions they did not start.
This MVP does not require real-time video streaming; it is explicitly metadata/status-driven.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui; compose them instead.
Respect existing Internet Identity auth model: unauthenticated users can browse but cannot upload/post or create live sessions.
nonGoals: Implement real-time live video streaming (e.g., WebRTC/HLS), low-latency chat, or WebSockets.
Add Discord OAuth/login or any Discord API integration beyond displaying the provided server/contact info.
Change or redesign already-implemented core video upload/watch features beyond adding guest messaging and the new Live MVP.
